premises.text: Aspiring music artists lack access to quality producers or cannot afford a music career
premises.evidence_span: they either don't have access to quality producers or they can't afford to pursue a career in music

premises.text: Producers with great beats lack relationships with artists to sell production and give beats away hoping to be discovered
premises.evidence_span: he doesn't have relationships with artists to sell his production

premises.text: An all-in-one mobile production marketplace, studio, and social network lets users create original songs with producers for under $5 from a phone
premises.evidence_span: an all-in-one mobile production marketplace, a recording studio, and a social network that allows our users to create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5

premises.text: Producers pay subscription fees to upload beats; the platform takes a cut of leases/sales and shares royalties back
premises.evidence_span: We basically charge producers $9.99 a month or $90 a year to upload our beats to our platform

premises.text: Growth uses affiliate marketers, field evangelists, and celebrity fan outreach rather than major-label licensing dependence
premises.evidence_span: we're not relying on major label licensing because we're an original content platform

value.text: Anyone can awaken their inner musician by creating and sharing original songs affordably on mobile
value.evidence_span: the ability to awaken their inner musician

secondary_value.text: Make money for producers while giving artists access and cost savings
secondary_value.evidence_span: we make money for producers like Tony, and we provide access and save money for guys like Willie

causal_links.evidence_span: Rekogram solves both Tony and Willie's problems
create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5
when those beats are leased or sold through our platform, we take 20% of the in-app purchase
